title: Introduce stability windows, anchor snapshots, and automated rollback playbook
author: Maya Thompson
commits: a1c9f3b: introduce StabilityWindow type and basic persistence
b7d2e8a: implement deterministic sample seeding and compact snapshot signature
c4f5e2d: anchor snapshot generator + CLI command registryctl anchor create
d2b1a7f: changelog micro-delta diff algorithm (seeded sampling mode)
e9f3b00: rollback playbook generator and alert hook integration
f1a22b4: docs and integration tests for stability windows and rollback flow
f8c33d1: CI flake fixes and added test fixtures
description:
Context: Model onboarding churn and noisy changelogs make it hard for SREs and product engineers to determine whether a new model profile change is genuinely material or an artifact of sampling. Small profile deltas frequently trigger downstream rollouts and manual reviews even when signals are within the expected instability of the dataset.

Goal: Provide a deterministic, time-bounded mechanism (StabilityWindow) to anchor profile snapshots, produce compact signatures for snapshots, compute reproducible micro-deltas with seeded sampling, and ship an automated rollback/rollforward playbook that can be executed by the curator CLI or surfaced in incident runbooks. This reduces surprise rollouts, makes changelogs more actionable, and shortens troubleshooting time for regressions.

What this PR contains: Adds a StabilityWindow abstraction to the model registry metadata (start_ts, end_ts, seed, snapshot_id), an anchor snapshot generator that emits a compact signature (SHA256 of canonicalized profile + seed) and deterministic sample indices, and a changelog micro-delta algorithm that computes diffs relative to the nearest anchor snapshot using seeded sampling to ensure reproducible summaries. The PR also adds a rollback_playbook generator which synthesizes step-by-step actions (rollback candidate, validation prompt sets, fast compare commands) and wires it into registryctl and the curator alert hook. Includes a backfill script to generate anchors for historical profiles and a small scheduler chart for creating periodic stability windows for high-traffic models.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc linked (internal RFC): /docs/rfcs/2024-09-stability-windows.md
- [x] Unit tests for snapshot signing and seeded sampling (pkg/onboard/*_test.go)
- [x] Integration test (tests/integration/snapshot_seeded_test.go)
- [x] Registryctl CLI commands and help text
- [x] Docs for operators and curators (docs/onboarding/*.md)
- [x] Backfill script and rollout plan for production models
- [x] Telemetry events for anchor creation and rollback playbook generation

High level changeset (files): pkg/onboard/snapshotter.go: new snapshot builder and signer; pkg/onboard/anchor_windows.go: stability window persistence and query helpers; internal/changes/changelog_diff.go: seeded micro-delta algorithm; cmd/registryctl/anchor.go and rollback_playbook.go: new CLI surface; scripts/backfill_anchor_snapshots.sh: helper to backfill anchors for an environment; docs/onboarding/*: operator and curator-facing docs; tests/integration: end-to-end seeded snapshot test; charts/registry/templates/cronjob.yaml: optional cron for periodic anchor creation.

Design notes and tradeoffs: The snapshot signature uses canonical JSON + a provided integer seed to ensure bit-exact snapshot signatures across languages and runners. The seeded sampling picks deterministic indices from the profile's example corpus; this keeps changelog diffs compact while making them reproducible for triage. We intentionally keep the StabilityWindow notion lightweight so it can be surfaced as an annotation on existing model version entities; longer-term we may add policy-driven window creation (SLO-driven). The rollback playbook generator emits a compact YAML with recommended validation prompts and quick-compare commands; it does not automatically execute rollbacks (safety first).

Commits summary and reasoning: See commits list. Most of the additions are tests, docs, and the snapshot/anchor implementation. The largest implementation risk was ensuring canonicalization of profiles across macOS/Linux/containers; added fixture-based cross-run tests to defend this.

Review notes: This PR intentionally keeps the sampling bucket size conservative (default 250 samples) and exposes configuration for heavy models to raise/lower sample size. We added telemetry events (anchor.created, rollback.generated) to help evaluate signal-to-noise and to guide future defaults.

CI: initial pipeline run hit a flaky e2e that relied on system time; fixed by pinning times in tests and re-running. Final CI status: all checks passing.

Merge: Squashed and merged after approvals. Rolling out to staging with backfill enabled for top 20 models in the next deploy window.

Related: ENG-1423 (stability windows feature), ENG-1489 (rollback playbook), RFC at /docs/rfcs/2024-09-stability-windows.md.
review_thread: Evan Kline (2024-11-07): Can we avoid using OS-dependent JSON marshalling order? Suggest using a canonicalizer that sorts keys and normalizes numbers.
Maya Thompson (2024-11-07): Agreed. Added a canonicalizeProfile function and tests to enforce stable output across platforms (pkg/onboard/canonicalize_test.go).
Rohit Patel (2024-11-08): The default sample size of 250 seems low for some of our latency/regression signal sets. Can we make this configurable per-model and add a warning in the UI?

Maya Thompson (2024-11-08): Added per-model sample_size config and a registryctl anchor create --sample-size flag. We'll follow up with a console PR for a UI warning; added a linked Linear task ENG-1516.
Sofia Martínez (2024-11-12): Could the rollback playbook include a suggested canary percentage and quick-metrics queries for latency and error-rate?

Maya Thompson (2024-11-12): Yes — playbook now emits suggested canary percentages (default 5/25/100) and sample kql queries for latency and token-error-rate. Added to docs/onboarding/rollback-playbook.md.
Evan Kline (2024-11-14): Tests look good; one nit on naming of anchor_id vs snapshot_id — prefer anchor_id for clarity.
Maya Thompson (2024-11-14): Renamed snapshot_id -> anchor_id and adjusted DB migration script.
release_notes: Added StabilityWindow and Anchor snapshots: deterministic snapshot signing and seeded sampling for reproducible changelogs; registryctl commands to create/list anchors; automated rollback playbook generator for faster triage. Backfill script provided to generate anchors for historical profiles. No breaking changes. Feature is behind a registry feature flag by default.
notes_for_ops: Rollout plan: deploy to staging, run scripts/backfill_anchor_snapshots.sh for top 20 models, evaluate anchor.created telemetry for 48h, then promote to canary and run backfill for additional models. Feature flag: registry.stability_windows.enabled
merge_comment: Squash-merged by Sofia Martínez after approvals. Backfill scheduled as part of Nov-16 deploy window.
